# Contributing to 7fchain

Thanks for helping. The most useful things you can do:

- **Mine on the testnet** and tell us how it went: [Become a miner](../docs/become-a-miner.md).
- **Ask and answer questions** in [Discussions](https://github.com/Seven-Fortunas/7fchain/discussions).
- **Report a problem** with a program or a guide, using the [issue forms](https://github.com/Seven-Fortunas/7fchain/issues/new/choose).
- **Report a security vulnerability privately**, as described in [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md). Never in a public issue.

## Pull requests

This repository holds the releases, guides and papers; it is published from our own sources. A pull request here would be overwritten by the next publish, so instead open a [docs issue](https://github.com/Seven-Fortunas/7fchain/issues/new?template=docs-problem.yml) with the change you suggest, and we'll make it.

## Be kind

Everyone here follows our [Code of Conduct](https://github.com/Seven-Fortunas/.github/blob/main/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md).
